left.raw_text: - Electively scheduled for surgical operation that require general anesthesia and expected duration of hospitalization of longer than one day (for patients in Perioperative Evaluation & Management [POEM]) or high clinical suspicion of sepsis by the emergency physician (for patients in emergency center)

right.raw_text: - Ability to give informed consent. If the patient is incapacitated and unable to give informed consent, the next-of-kin or a person who has the power of attorney must be present for informed consent.

left.raw_text: - For patients in the emergency center only, two or more of the following SIRS criteria:
- Leukocytes > 12,000/mm^3 or < 4,000/mm^3 or > 10% immature (band) forms, provided that no filgrastim or pegfilgrastim was administered within 30 days and no leukemia

right.raw_text: - Respiratory rate > 20 breaths/min or partial pressure of carbon dioxide (CO2) < 32 mmHg
